preconditions: These function names are proposed private functions, not existing APIs.
Direct blocked policy and group gossip_peer_blocked checks must precede local checkpoint access as in the original paths.
The gate expression is evaluated outside any branch on the private result it classifies.
Upstream authenticated receive control must already be correctly reviewed by its owner; no gate clears unrelated caller branchPC.
Path, wrapping key, authenticated account/device and group route are separate locally sourced arguments, never extracted from a private control or published plan.
No public forwarder, test-support production export, callback or caller-constructed flag can reach a release.
No new release is permitted in observe_gossip, observe_group_gossip, GossipState, TransparencySafety or Bounty.
scope.result_handling: Pure helpers compute private payloads and private decisions. Only the listed finite projection is a candidate for release. Payload extraction stays pure; do not branch on the original Result/Option again around effects. Error-frontier entries below are unresolved, not implicit catch-all permissions.

finite_candidates.name: authenticated_gossip_control_disposition
finite_candidates.projection: None -> IgnoreMalformed; Some(CheckpointRequest) -> Request; Some(CheckpointAnswer) -> Answer
finite_candidates.placement: After own_checkpoint succeeds; before load_gossip_state; IgnoreMalformed returns without peer-state access.
finite_candidates.reason: authenticated gossip receive reviews only malformed suppression or request versus answer disposition; body, IDs, hint, checkpoint, witnesses, reciprocal flag and unrelated caller control remain private

finite_candidates.name: authenticated_gossip_request_admitted
finite_candidates.placement: After request peer-state load; before next_answer deadline, own_witnesses and answer encoding, in that order.
finite_candidates.reason: authenticated gossip request reviews only whether the existing daily answer budget and pending control permit an answer; deadline values, queued content, request ID and unrelated caller control remain private

finite_candidates.name: authenticated_gossip_answer_correlated
finite_candidates.projection: id equals state.request_id OR id equals state.reply_id
finite_candidates.placement: After answer peer-state load; false suppresses before native config or checkpoint verification.
finite_candidates.reason: authenticated gossip answer reviews only whether either outstanding identifier matches; identifier bytes, individual match bits, digests and unrelated caller control remain private

finite_candidates.name: authenticated_gossip_answer_checkpoint_status
finite_candidates.projection: Pure typed verify_checkpoint result: Ok(false), Ok(true), or the exact three existing constant error classes.
finite_candidates.prerequisite: A pure typed verifier core or equivalent exhaustive proof of its error domain; no wildcard String classifier. This prerequisite is not implemented in preparations-only.patch.
finite_candidates.placement: After original native config read; Invalid suppresses, errors propagate, Verified continues to the same-log decision. Preserve original validation order.
finite_candidates.reason: authenticated gossip answer reviews only checkpoint signature acceptance or its three existing verification error classes under the native log key; checkpoint fields, signature bytes and unrelated caller control remain private

finite_candidates.name: authenticated_gossip_answer_same_log
finite_candidates.placement: After incoming checkpoint verification; false skips signed-conflict config, policy, finder creation and witness reads but still permits the original ID clearing path.
finite_candidates.reason: authenticated gossip answer reviews only whether local and received checkpoints belong to the same log version for fork evaluation; version values, checkpoint fields and unrelated caller control remain private

finite_candidates.name: authenticated_gossip_fork_selected
finite_candidates.projection: prepare_signed_conflict(selected canonical candidate, native log key, pins) is Some; same-size is attempted first, rollback only on its Err.
finite_candidates.placement: After original config, policy, zero-finder, own-witness and paired-attestation preparation. Does not authorize retain_fork(private_proof).
finite_candidates.reason: authenticated gossip fork selection reviews only whether the original same-size-first then rollback verifiers selected a proof; proof fields, verifier errors, witness identities and unrelated caller control remain private
finite_candidates.blocker: The selected proof remains private. Bounty reparses it before storage. This finite bit cannot authorize publication or complete retention.

finite_candidates.name: authenticated_gossip_reciprocal_answer_required
finite_candidates.projection: expected_request && incoming request_peer && old state.pending_body is empty
finite_candidates.placement: Only after signed_conflict, including any retention/revalidation/CAS, succeeds. Clear each matching ID privately. True reads own_witnesses and encodes the reciprocal answer with flag false; false saves the cleared state.
finite_candidates.reason: authenticated gossip answer reviews only whether a reciprocal answer must be queued; incoming flag, individual ID matches, identifier bytes, queued content and unrelated caller control remain private

finite_candidates.name: authenticated_gossip_state_encoding_status
finite_candidates.projection: Closed status of private encode_gossip_state(selected.effective), preserving first failure.
finite_candidates.prerequisite: Convert the proposed private framing core to a closed GossipFrameError before adding this release; the submitted extraction still returns private String errors.
finite_candidates.placement: After control-body encoding, queued_group_peers read, pure queue selection and public peer-label validation; before local_context and state seal.
finite_candidates.reason: authenticated gossip persistence reviews only ready or the three existing state framing error classes before storage sealing; encoded state, deadlines, identifiers, queue fields, exact lengths and unrelated caller control remain private

finite_candidates.name: authenticated_gossip_queue_index_required
finite_candidates.placement: After state sealing succeeds. False returns its writes; true prepares then seals the index before the joint store.
finite_candidates.reason: authenticated gossip persistence reviews only whether the group queue index must accompany the sealed peer record; queue membership, counts, pending fields and unrelated caller control remain private

finite_candidates.name: authenticated_gossip_queue_encoding_status
finite_candidates.prerequisite: Closed error type for gossip_join; no arbitrary String release.
finite_candidates.placement: After the successful state seal and required-index decision; before index local_context/seal and store_updated_blobs. No speculative nonce reservation.
finite_candidates.reason: authenticated gossip persistence reviews only ready or the existing queue concatenation failure before sealing its index; peer bytes, queue membership, exact lengths and unrelated caller control remain private

error_frontiers_not_closed.chain: encode_gossip -> encode_hint / encode_checkpoint -> checkpoint_bytes / encode_witnesses -> vector and integer primitives
error_frontiers_not_closed.requirement: Preserve original error payload and priority privately. A finite error-class gate needs a reviewed exhaustive typed domain; a Result-tag-only design would additionally need a complete private-error return/caller audit. Neither is implemented here.

error_frontiers_not_closed.chain: paired_attestations -> matching_attestation -> verify_witnesses -> checkpoint_hash / witness_signature_valid -> C2spText
error_frontiers_not_closed.requirement: Do not silently suppress propagated preparation errors. Only the original fork_same_size and fork_rollback Errs are suppressed. A future gate must preserve that distinction and original first error.

error_frontiers_not_closed.chain: retain_fork -> encode_fork -> retain_bounty_fork -> decode_fork? -> finder-zero encode_fork? -> retain -> current -> storage/CAS
error_frontiers_not_closed.requirement: Caller-side finite gates cannot remove private parse/encode control inside unchanged Bounty. No complete finite-only diff exists in this artifact.

VO owns upstream authenticated receive control and downstream caller results. Separately check inbox.flush_gossip, GossipSend and GroupGossip. No finite gossip gate is a blanket continuation permission.

hint_path.status: No additional hint disclosure proposed by this body-label design.
hint_path.reason: The declared semantic private field is body; direct extensions and GroupPayload.hint are separate fields. Preserve their actual dependency labels rather than assuming either universal privacy or universal publicity.
hint_path.ordering: own checkpoint -> parse -> peer state -> own/known equality -> hourly/pending budget -> persist checked state -> same-size/range decision -> local origin -> consistency request -> known_hint save or daily/random-ID/request queue path
hint_path.constraint: If a hint/range/origin is private at a real caller, a finite request/no-request bit does not authorize sending its sizes or URL over HTTP. Keep that route refused until its actual metadata source is resolved. Do not add a hash or length release as a workaround.

conditional_evidence_exception.status: NOT APPROVED; non-finite disclosure, not part of finite_candidates
conditional_evidence_exception.name: authenticated_gossip_canonical_fork_evidence
conditional_evidence_exception.type: Plaintext<Bytes> -> Bytes, restricted to the exact canonical FRK schema in authority-and-caller-report.txt
conditional_evidence_exception.candidate_reason: authenticated fork publication releases only canonical finder-zero evidence constructed from the exact local checkpoint and correlated received checkpoint after native log verification, same-size-first or rollback proof verification and exact paired-witness binding; message bodies, IDs, unused metadata, local preferences, routing and unrelated caller control remain private
required_binding: Native pinned service key, same log version and complete signed checkpoint fields including sequence, root, size, previous hash and timestamp.
First equals the captured local checkpoint; second equals the exact correlated received checkpoint; no arbitrary incoming ForkProof.
Kind 1 from successful same-size verification or kind 3 only after same-size Err and successful rollback; contradiction None; no anchor variant.
Finder equals exactly 32 locally generated zero bytes.
Only original paired_attestations output in pin order, each assigned to its exact checkpoint hash and locally pinned witness key; preserve 64/72-byte forms and zero-witness service forks.
Canonical encode/decode equality to those selected fields; no appended fields, original unselected witness list or error payload.
conditional_evidence_exception.after_release: Decode the published canonical wire as public data and invoke unchanged retain_fork for policy re-read/revalidation and unchanged Bounty first-proof/preference CAS. Do not precheck or duplicate CAS, bypass revalidation or retry rollback after retention failure.
conditional_evidence_exception.limit: A hypothetical exception identifies a possible removal of the private-proof parse blocker, not verified compilation or authorization to add it. Without it or separately owned Bounty API work, full closure remains blocked.
